metadata.source_note: Minimal contract for a local-only CREATURE_ATTACKS -> CREATE_TOKEN bridge with strict explicit wording and no combat-engine expansion.

bridge_kind.label: creature_attacks -> create_token
bridge_kind.purpose: Enable strict local closure where an explicit this-creature-attacks trigger co-exists with local create-token payoff wording.

activation_scope.description: Bridge applies only within the same local card/profile.

activation_predicate.text_evidence_policy: Require explicit wording equivalent to 'Whenever this creature attacks, create ... token.'
honesty_constraints: Reject 'one or more creatures attack' wording.
Reject create-token text without explicit this-creature-attacks trigger.
